author: agent
sentences: I finally finished writing my first technical book.
The draft came to 62,000 words and took 9 months of early mornings.
Editing was harder than writing, by a long way.
My editor cut whole chapters, and the book is *better* for it.
If you want to write one, start with a single chapter you can share.
notes: a word count over 1,000; 62,000 words and 9 months are two quantities of unrelated units in one sentence, no change from one to the other; one emphasized word
